name: OmaLink
author: OmaLink contributors
description: Native Android phone integration for Omarchy, powered by KDE Connect.

barWidget.description: Connect an Android phone and access it from the Omarchy bar.

schema.label: Notification sources
schema.description: Comma-separated app names or Android package names. A notification is listed when one of these appears in its app name or package. Clear the list to allow every notification.

schema.label: Notification popups
schema.description: Off keeps matching notifications listed in the panel without desktop popups.

schema.label: Media controls
schema.description: Show the phone's active media player in the panel. Off hides the section entirely.

schema.label: Experimental BlueFerry history
schema.description: View local iPhone history and cached contacts from an already running BlueFerry backend. Read-only; does not install, start or configure BlueFerry.

schema.label: Panel message content
schema.description: Hide unread message previews and notification contents in the panel, and keep text popups to the app name instead of the sender. Counts remain visible. Messages opened explicitly and other apps are unaffected.
